svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram name="OVP93x connection overview" id="ovp93x-connections">   </diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: OVP93x connection example
svg.desc: Two O3R335 heads connected to Port0–Port3: camera 1 uses Port0 for 2D and Port1 for 3D; camera 2 uses Port2 for 2D and Port3 for 3D. Ethernet connects to a computer. The power connector pinout is shown separately. The hardware components and cables are editable in draw.io.

g.text: Example wiring — 2D and 3D may use any Port0–Port3.
